###FIGURE 1a.
```{r Figure 1a}
##Clustering

#Checking new clustering
DefaultAssay(immune.combined) <- "integrated"

# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
#immune.combined <- ScaleData(immune.combined, verbose = FALSE)
immune.combined <- RunPCA(immune.combined, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
immune.combined <- RunUMAP(immune.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
immune.combined <- FindNeighbors(immune.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)

##Changing clusters names
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2 <- NA
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "cMonocyte-COQ7_11213"))] <- "cMonocyte-COQ7"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "cMonocyte-IL_02614"))] <- "cMonocyte-IL1B"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "cMonocyte-ISG15_10"))] <- "cMonocyte-ISG15"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "cMonocyte-S100A8_79"))] <- "cMonocyte-S100A8"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "DCs1_15"))] <- "DCs1"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "DCs2_511"))] <- "DCs2"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "intMonocyte_3"))] <- "int-Monocyte"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "ncMonocyte-CD16_48"))] <- "nc-Monocyte"
immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2[which(str_detect(immune.combined@meta.data$celltype, "pDCs_16"))] <- "pDCs"

##Fixing levels of some variables
celltype_levels <- c("cMonocyte-IL1B","cMonocyte-S100A8",
                     "cMonocyte-COQ7","cMonocyte-ISG15",
                     "int-Monocyte", "nc-Monocyte", 
                     "DCs1", "DCs2", "pDCs")

immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2 <- factor(x = immune.combined@meta.data$celltype2, levels = celltype_levels)

Idents(immune.combined) <- "celltype2"
Idents(immune.combined) <- "integrated_snn_res.0.3"

Tfh_colors_list <- c("#9e0142", "#f4a582", "#5e4fa2", "#66c2a5","#74add1",
                     "#8c510a", "#bf812d", "#fee090", "#01665e", "#b2abd2", "#f8ac0e", "#007b40")

```

####Figure 1e Barplot cellnumbers per donor per different days####
```{r Figure 1e Barplot cellnumbers per donor per different days}
Fig1EMeta <- immune.combined@meta.data
colnames(Fig1EMeta)
Fig1EMeta_Freq <- as.data.frame(table(Fig1EMeta$donor_id, Fig1EMeta$celltype2, Fig1EMeta$day))
#Renaming columns
colnames(Fig1EMeta_Freq)[1] ="Donor"
colnames(Fig1EMeta_Freq)[2] ="Celltype"
colnames(Fig1EMeta_Freq)[3] ="Day"
colnames(Fig1EMeta_Freq)[4] ="Count"
head(Fig1EMeta_Freq)

##Creating celltype factors
celltype_fact<- c("cMonocyte-IL1B","cMonocyte-S100A8", "cMonocyte-COQ7", "cMonocyte-ISG15", "int-Monocyte", "nc-Monocyte", "DCs1", "DCs2", "pDCs")
##Creating day factors
Fig1EMeta_Freq$Celltype <- factor(Fig1EMeta_Freq$Celltype, levels = celltype_fact)

##Creating day factors
day_fact<- c("day0","day8", "day36")
##Creating day factors
Fig1EMeta_Freq$Day <- factor(Fig1EMeta_Freq$Day, levels = day_fact)

##Creating donors factors
donor_fact<- c("donor0","donor1", "donor2", "donor3")
##Creating day factors
Fig1EMeta_Freq$Donor <- factor(Fig1EMeta_Freq$Donor, levels = donor_fact)

# Calculate the proportions
Fig1EMeta_Prop <- Fig1EMeta_Freq %>%
  group_by(Donor, Day) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count)*100) %>%
  ungroup()

#Figure1E-Barplot with cell numbers per donor
pop_clus <- ggplot(data = Fig1EMeta_Prop, aes(x = Day, y = Proportion, fill = Celltype)) +
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Tfh_colors_list) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  facet_grid(~ Donor, scales = "free") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = 'black'),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
  ) 

pop_clus

#ggsave("output_for_paper/Fig1E_Barplot_NoCells_per_DonorDay_16724.pdf", plot = pop_clus,
#      height = 8, width = 16, dpi = 300)
```

###Figure 1C, dimplot before and after integration 
```{r Figure 1C, dimplot before and after integration }
##Read in data
ibsm.mono.F <- readRDS(file = "data/IBSM_mono_filtered_210823.rds")
##Before integration
#### NORMALISATION #########
#adjust the limit for allowable object sizes within R 
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4000 * 1024^2)

ibsm.mono.F <- SCTransform(ibsm.mono.F, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = TRUE)


#### DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION
# This step gives equal weight in downstream analyses, so that highly-expressed genes do not dominate
ibsm.mono.F   <- RunPCA(ibsm.mono.F  , npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
ibsm.mono.F   <- RunUMAP(ibsm.mono.F  , reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
ibsm.mono.F   <- FindNeighbors(ibsm.mono.F  , reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)

##Plotting
Idents(ibsm.mono.F) <- "day_donor"
ddd <- DimPlot(ibsm.mono.F, label = FALSE, cols= Tfh_colors_list, pt.size = 2, group.by = "day_donor") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=Tfh_colors_list)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

##After integration

immune.combined <- readRDS( "data/IBSM_monoSCT_integbyDayDonor_220823.rds")

DefaultAssay(immune.combined) <- "integrated"
Idents(immune.combined) <- "day_donor"
eee <- DimPlot(immune.combined, label = FALSE, cols= Tfh_colors_list, pt.size = 2, group.by = "day_donor") + scale_fill_manual(values=Tfh_colors_list)

ddd+eee
#ggsave("output_for_paper/Sup_Fig_1C_dimplot_prepostIntegration.pdf", plot = (ddd+eee),
#       height = 6, width = 10, dpi = 300)
```

### Venn Diagram

```{r Reading significant genes output}
#### Getting the gene list and selecting the top 10 per cluster/day ####
sigDGEs <- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/psbulk_sigGens__all_DayClusters.csv", row.names=1)


sigDGEs_sub<- sigDGEs[sigDGEs$cluster_name %in% c("cMonocyte-COQ7", "cMonocyte-IL",
                                                  "cMonocyte-ISG15", "cMonocyte-S100A8"),]

# Creating direction variable
sigDGEs_sub$dir_sig[sigDGEs_sub$logFC>0] <-"up"
sigDGEs_sub$dir_sig[sigDGEs_sub$logFC<0] <-"down"
#Adding new name
sigDGEs_sub$cluster_name = factor(sigDGEs_sub$cluster_name,
                                  labels = c("cMonocyte-IL"="CM1",                                                                        "cMonocyte-S100A8"="CM2",                                                                    "cMonocyte-COQ7"="CM3",                                                                      "cMonocyte-ISG15"="CM4"))

sigDGEs_sub<- sigDGEs_sub[sigDGEs_sub$day %in% c("day36","day8"),]
table(sigDGEs_sub$cluster_name, sigDGEs_sub$day )

```

```{r venn diagram CM1}
sigDGEs_CM1<- sigDGEs_sub[sigDGEs_sub$cluster_name %in% "CM1",]
#Change colnames
colnames(sigDGEs_CM1)[1] ="celltype"
colnames(sigDGEs_CM1)[4] ="Log2FC"
colnames(sigDGEs_CM1)[8] ="p_adj"

# 1. Get unique gene lists for each group
day8Genes_CM1   <- unique(sigDGEs_CM1 %>% filter(day == "day8") %>% pull(gene))

day36Genes_CM1   <- unique(sigDGEs_CM1 %>% filter(day == "day36") %>% pull(gene))

# 2. Compute the disjoint sets (Venn regions)

# Double intersection
day8_day36_CM1 <- Reduce(intersect, list(day8Genes_CM1, day36Genes_CM1))

# Unique only
d8_only_CM1   <- setdiff(day8Genes_CM1, day8_day36_CM1)
d36_only_CM1   <- setdiff(day36Genes_CM1, day8_day36_CM1)

venn_db_CM1 <- as.data.frame(bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "d8_only",  gene = d8_only_CM1),
  tibble(set = "d36_only", gene = d36_only_CM1),
  tibble(set = "inter",    gene = day8_day36_CM1)
)) %>% mutate(celltype="CM1")

# 3. Construct named region vector for eulerr
fit1_CM1 <- euler(c(
  "day8"  = length(day8Genes_CM1),
  "day8&day36"= length(day8_day36_CM1),
  "day36" = length(day36Genes_CM1)
  ))

# 4. Plot the Venn diagram with correct disjoint counts
pdf("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/VennDiagram_CM1.pdf")

plot(
  fit1_CM1,
  main="CM1",
  quantities = TRUE,
  fills = list(fill = c("#fdae61", "#0072B2"), alpha = 0.5),
  edges = list(lwd = 1),
  labels = list(font = 2)
) 
dev.off()
```

```{r venn diagram CM2}
#Change colnames
colnames(sigDGEs_CM2)[1] ="celltype"
```

```{r venn diagram CM3}
day8_day36_CM3 <- Reduce(intersect, list(day8Genes_CM3, day36Genes_CM3))

# Unique only
d8_only_CM3   <- setdiff(day8Genes_CM3, day8_day36_CM3)
d36_only_CM3  <- setdiff(day36Genes_CM3, day8_day36_CM3)

venn_db_CM3 <- as.data.frame(bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "d8_only",  gene = d8_only_CM3),
  tibble(set = "d36_only", gene = d36_only_CM3),
  tibble(set = "inter",    gene = day8_day36_CM3)
))%>% mutate(celltype="CM3")

# 3. Construct named region vector for eulerr
fit1_CM3 <- euler(c(
  "day8"  = length(day8Genes_CM3),
  "day8&day36"= length(day8_day36_CM3),
  "day36" = length(day36Genes_CM3)
  ))

# 4. Plot the Venn diagram with correct disjoint counts
pdf("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/VennDiagram_CM3.pdf")

plot(
  fit1_CM3,
  main="CM3",
  quantities = TRUE,
  fills = list(fill = c("#fdae61", "#0072B2"), alpha = 0.5),
  edges = list(lwd = 1),
  labels = list(font = 2)
) 

dev.off()
```

```{r, combining venn and edger results }
psbDE_CM1 <- sigDGEs_sub %>%
  filter(cluster_name == "CM1") %>%
  mutate(set = dplyr::case_when(
    gene %in% d8_only_CM1      ~ "d8_only",
    gene %in% d36_only_CM1     ~ "d36_only",
    gene %in% day8_day36_CM1   ~ "d8&d36",
    TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
  ))

psbDE_CM2 <- sigDGEs_sub %>%
  filter(cluster_name == "CM2") %>%
  mutate(set = dplyr::case_when(
    gene %in% d8_only_CM2      ~ "d8_only",
    gene %in% d36_only_CM2     ~ "d36_only",
    gene %in% day8_day36_CM2   ~ "d8&d36",
    TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
  ))

psbDE_CM3 <- sigDGEs_sub %>%
  filter(cluster_name == "CM3") %>%
  mutate(set = dplyr::case_when(
    gene %in% d8_only_CM3      ~ "d8_only",
    gene %in% d36_only_CM3     ~ "d36_only",
    gene %in% day8_day36_CM3   ~ "d8&d36",
    TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
  ))

psbDE_CM4 <- sigDGEs_sub %>%
  filter(cluster_name == "CM4") %>%
  mutate(set = dplyr::case_when(
    gene %in% d8_only_CM4      ~ "d8_only",
    gene %in% d36_only_CM4     ~ "d36_only",
    gene %in% day8_day36_CM4   ~ "d8&d36",
    TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
  ))


psbDE_venn = rbind(psbDE_CM1, psbDE_CM2, psbDE_CM3, psbDE_CM4)


###We have the genes classify within cluster, now we need to classify based on the 4 clusters


# Step 1: Calculate the total number of clusters in the dataset
total_clusters <- n_distinct(psbDE_venn$cluster_name)  # = 4 in your case

# Step 2: For each gene, count how many clusters it appears in
# for each set category
gene_set_counts <- psbDE_venn %>%
  select(gene, cluster_name, set) %>%
  distinct() %>%                          # one row per gene-cluster-set combination
  group_by(gene, set) %>%
  summarise(
    n_clusters = n_distinct(cluster_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(ratio = n_clusters / total_clusters)  # e.g. 2/4 = 0.50

# Step 3: For each gene, find which set has the highest ratio
# and check it meets the 50% threshold
gene_classification <- gene_set_counts %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(ratio, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  # take the dominant set
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(set2 = case_when(
    ratio >= 0.5 & set == "d8_only"  ~ "d8_only",
    ratio >= 0.5 & set == "d36_only" ~ "d36_only",
    ratio >= 0.5 & set %in% c("inter", "d8&d36") ~ "d8&d36",
    TRUE ~ "other"                    # doesn't meet 50% threshold in any set
  )) %>%
  select(gene, set2, ratio, n_clusters)

# Step 4: Join set2 back to the original dataset
psbDE_venn <- psbDE_venn %>%
  left_join(gene_classification, by = "gene")

# Step 5: Summary
psbDE_venn %>%
  select(gene, set2) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(set2, name = "n_unique_genes") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_unique_genes)) %>%
  print()

write.csv(psbDE_venn,"/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/venn_input_ibsm40monos.csv")
```

```{r heatmap of intersect genes}
sigDGEs <- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/venn_input_ibsm40monos.csv", row.names=1)

#Adding new name
```

```{r heatmap of uniquely expressed genes per day}
  filter(set %in% c("d8_only", "d36_only")) %>%

  mutate(n_clupgene = length(cluster_name)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_clupgene >2) %>%

merged_genes1$gene = gsub("-", ".", merged_genes1$gene)
merged_genes2 <- unique(merged_genes1$gene)

#### subsetting our selected genes
dfsub_d816<- as.matrix(Average.sub[, colnames(Average.sub) %in% merged_genes2])

dfsub_d816 <- as.matrix(dfsub_d816)

col = list(Cluster = c("CM1" = "#9e0142",

)

  filter(gene %in% merged_genes2) %>%           # keep only genes in merged_genes2
  select(gene, set) %>% 
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%          # one row per gene
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = c("d8_only", "d36_only")))

# Align 'set' to the heatmap row order (genes)

  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,                  # (explicit; no column dendrogram)
  column_split = col_split,

  row_gap = unit(1, "mm"),

)

dev.off()
```

#PCA from ATACseq data
```{r ATACseq PCA from modelled data}
##Reading data

metall_dglis_t = read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/ATACseq_R4.4/ATAC_seq/output/data4PCA.csv",row.names = 1)

#Compute PCA
res.pca <- prcomp(metall_dglis_t, scale = TRUE)
metall_dglis_t_sub<-metall_dglis_t%>%select(group,batch,Replicate)%>%
  mutate(group=case_when(
    group==1 ~ "d0",
    group==2 ~ "d8",
    group==3 ~ "d27"),
         sample_id=paste0(Replicate,"_",group))
# Create a data frame for ggplot2
pca_metadata <- data.frame(PC1 = res.pca$x[,1], PC2 = res.pca$x[,2], SampleID = metall_dglis_t_sub$sample_id, Group = metall_dglis_t_sub$group, Batch = metall_dglis_t_sub$batch, Sample = metall_dglis_t_sub$Replicate)
##Creating factors
pca_metadata <- pca_metadata%>%
  mutate(SampleID = as.factor(SampleID),
         Group = factor(Group, levels=c("d0", "d8", "d27")),
         Batch = as.factor(Batch),
         Sample = paste0("R",Sample),
         Sample = as.factor(Sample))

# "d0"= "#bababa", 
# Plot
colz <- c("d0"="#fdae61",  "d8"="darkgreen", "d27"="blue")
#colz <- c("d0"= "darkred", "d8"="darkblue",  "d15"="darkgreen", "d27"="lightblue")

pca_nosva <- ggplot(pca_metadata, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, shape = Batch)) +  # Added shape = Group
 geom_point(size = 4) +
 xlab(paste0("PC1: ", round(summary(res.pca)$importance[2,1] * 100, 2), "% variance")) +
 ylab(paste0("PC2: ", round(summary(res.pca)$importance[2,2] * 100, 2), "% variance")) +
 scale_color_manual(values = colz) +
 scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17))+  # Added shape scale
 theme_bw()

# Plot the PCA
 pca_nosva
# Save it
 ggsave(pca_nosva, filename = "/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/ATACseq_R4.4/ATAC_seq/output/chmi_1_m/Variance_analysis/PCA_Peaks_timepoint_nd15.pdf",  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600,scale = 1)
```

###PCA with ellipse

```{r ATACseq PCA main fig days with elipse}
# time-ordered, colorblind-friendly palette
colz3 <- c(
  "d0"  = "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "d8" = "#009E73",  # bluish green
  "d27" = "#D55E00"   # vermillion
)

# matching, slightly lighter fills for ellipses
fillz3 <- c(
  "d0"  = "#A6D7F2",
  "d8" = "#7FD7B5",
  "d27" = "#F3A476"
)

pca_nosva5 <- ggplot(pca_metadata, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  # axes
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +

  # ellipses (filled + outline)
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(color = Group, fill = Group),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    level  = 0.95
  ) +

  # sample points: filled symbols with black edge
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Group, shape = Group),
    size   = 4,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +

  # group means: larger black “x”
stat_summary(
    data = pca_metadata,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, group = Group),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 1,
    size = 0,
    stroke = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE)+

# labels
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", round(summary(res.pca)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 2), "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", round(summary(res.pca)$importance[2, 2] * 100, 2), "% variance")) +

  # manual scales
  scale_color_manual(values = colz3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = fillz3) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("d0" = 21, "d8" = 21, "d27" = 21)) +

  # clean theme
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey70"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA)
  )
pca_nosva5
pdf("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/ATACseq_R4.4/ATAC_seq/output/chmi_1_m/Variance_analysis/PCA_Peaks_timepoint_chmi1_m_v2_elipse1_main_090226.pdf",  width = 7, height = 5)

dev.off()
```

```{r lets try complex heatmap for shared genes on day 8 and day 36}
##getting the data
psbDE_venn0<- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/venn_input_ibsm40monos.csv", row.names = 1)


psbDE_venn2 <- psbDE_venn0 %>%
  mutate(
    groups = case_when(
      set == "d8_only" ~ paste0(cluster_name, ".","d8"),
      set == "d36_only" ~ paste0(cluster_name, ".","d36"),
      set == "inter" ~ paste0(cluster_name, ".","d8&",cluster_name,".","d36"),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    groups = factor(groups, levels=c("CM1.d8", "CM1.d36","CM1.d8&CM1.d36",
                                   "CM2.d8", "CM2.d36", "CM2.d8&CM2.d36",
                                   "CM3.d8", "CM3.d36",  "CM3.d8&CM3.d36",
                                   "CM4.d8", "CM4.d36", "CM4.d8&CM4.d36")),
    groups2 = case_when(
      groups == "CM1.d8&CM1.d36" & day == "day8" ~ "CM1.d8",
      groups == "CM1.d8&CM1.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM1.d36",
      groups == "CM2.d8&CM2.d36" & day == "day8" ~ "CM2.d8",
      groups == "CM2.d8&CM2.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM2.d36",
      groups == "CM3.d8&CM3.d36" & day == "day8" ~ "CM3.d8",
      groups == "CM3.d8&CM3.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM3.d36",
      groups == "CM4.d8&CM4.d36" & day == "day8" ~ "CM4.d8",
      groups == "CM4.d8&CM4.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM4.d36",
      TRUE ~ groups))

psbDE_venn2.ls = split(psbDE_venn2$gene, f=psbDE_venn2$groups2)

##drawing the plot
m = make_comb_mat(psbDE_venn2.ls, mode = "intersect")
set_name(m)
#"CM1.d36" "CM1.d8"  "CM2.d36" "CM2.d8"  "CM3.d36" "CM3.d8"  "CM4.d36" "CM4.d8" 
comb_name(m)
m2 <- m[, c("10000000","01000000","11000000",
            "00100000","00010000","00110000",
            "00001000","00000100","00001100",
            "00000010","00000001", "00000011")]
set_cols =
c("CM1.d8"  = "#9e0142",
  "CM1.d36" = "#9e0142",
  "CM2.d8" = "#f4a582",
  "CM2.d36" = "#f4a582",
  "CM3.d8" = "#5e4fa2",
  "CM3.d36" = "#5e4fa2",
  "CM4.d8" = "#66c2a5",
  "CM4.d36" = "#66c2a5")
##Getting the up/down table

gene_dir <- psbDE_venn2 %>%
  distinct(gene, day, dir_sig) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    dir_sig = ifelse(any(dir_sig == "down"), "down", "up"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cn <- comb_name(m2)

# FIX: extract_comb needs index, not name
genes_by_comb <- lapply(cn, function(nm) extract_comb(m2, nm))
names(genes_by_comb) <- cn

stack_counts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(genes_by_comb, function(g) {
  idx <- match(g, gene_dir$gene)
  d <- gene_dir$dir_sig[idx]
  d <- d[!is.na(d)]
  c(
    down = sum(d == "down"),
    up   = sum(d == "up")
  )
}))
rownames(stack_counts) <- cn

lab_du_2 <- paste0(stack_counts[, "down"], "/", stack_counts[, "up"])

ha_stack <- HeatmapAnnotation (
  "Intersection size (up/down)" = anno_barplot(
    stack_counts,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    beside = FALSE,
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(fill = c(down = "#377eb8", up = "#4daf4a")),
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
    height = unit(6, "cm"),
    width = unit(10,"cm"),
    add_numbers = TRUE,
    annotation_name_side = "right",
    annotation_name_rot = 0
  ),
   "down/up" = anno_text(lab_du_2, rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
)

pdf("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/training_monos_data4graphs/UpsetR_DEGs_D8D36_shareIntes_freq_withupdown.pdf", h=8, w =8)
UpSet(
  m2,
  pt_size = unit(5, "pt"),
  lwd = unit(2, "pt"),
  top_annotation = ha_stack, 
  right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(
    m2,
    add_numbers = TRUE,
    gp = gpar(fill = set_cols),
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    axis_param = list(side = "top"),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4), #changes font size of "set size" labels
                     width = unit(182, units = "pt"),
                     heatmap_height = unit(65, units = "pt")
  )
  )
dev.off()

##Getting a csv with the gene names per instersection
genes_tbl_d <- bind_rows(lapply(names(genes_by_comb), function(id) {
  tibble(
    intersection = id,
    gene = genes_by_comb[[id]]
  )
}))

set_levels <- set_name(m2)
##Function to decode information
decode_intersection <- function(bitstring, sets) {
  bits <- strsplit(bitstring, "")[[1]] == "1"
  paste(sets[bits], collapse = "&")
}

genes_tbl_d <- genes_tbl_d %>%
  mutate(
    set_name = vapply(
      intersection,
      decode_intersection,
      character(1),
      sets = set_levels
    )
  )
```

```{r Upset plot from complex heatmap for shared genes among days within same clusters}
}))

    annotation_name_side = "right",

)

 comb_order = order(comb_size(m3_ord),decreasing = TRUE),

  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4), #changes font size of "set size" labels

  )
  )
dev.off()

  )
}))

set_levels3 <- set_name(m3)
##Function to decode information
decode_intersection3 <- function(bitstring, sets) {
  bits <- strsplit(bitstring, "")[[1]] == "1"
  paste(sets[bits], collapse = "&")
}

genes_tbl_d3 <- genes_tbl_d3 %>%
  mutate(
    set_name = vapply(
      intersection,
      decode_intersection3,
      character(1),
      sets = set_levels3
    )
  )
```

```{r sanity check_ }
####sanity check venn vs upset####
##day36
# 1. Get unique gene lists for each group
day36Genes_CM1   <- unique(sigDGEs %>% filter(cluster_day =="CM1_day36") %>% pull(gene))

day36Genes_CM2   <- unique(sigDGEs %>% filter(cluster_day =="CM2_day36") %>% pull(gene))

# 2. Compute the disjoint sets (Venn regions)

# Double intersection
CM1_CM2_d36 <- Reduce(intersect, list(day36Genes_CM2, day36Genes_CM1))

# Unique only
CM1d36_only  <- setdiff(day36Genes_CM1, CM1_CM2_d36)
CM2d36_only    <- setdiff(day36Genes_CM2, CM1_CM2_d36)

venn_db_CM1 <- as.data.frame(bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "CM1d36_only",  gene = CM1d36_only),
  tibble(set = "CM2d36_only", gene = CM2d36_only),
  tibble(set = "inter",    gene = CM1_CM2_d36)
)) %>% mutate(day="day36")

# 3. Construct named region vector for eulerr
fit1_CM1 <- euler(c(
  "CM1d36"  = length(day36Genes_CM1),
  "CM1d36&CM2d36"= length(CM1_CM2_d36),
  "CM2d36" = length(day36Genes_CM2)
  ))

# 4. Plot the Venn diagram with correct disjoint counts
plot(
  fit1_CM1,
  main="CM1",
  quantities = TRUE,
  fills = list(fill = c("#fdae61", "#0072B2"), alpha = 0.5),
  edges = list(lwd = 1),
  labels = list(font = 2)
) 

####day8 ####
# 1. Get unique gene lists for each group
day8Genes_CM1   <- unique(sigDGEs %>% filter(cluster_day =="CM1_day8") %>% pull(gene))

day8Genes_CM2   <- unique(sigDGEs %>% filter(cluster_day =="CM2_day8") %>% pull(gene))

# 2. Compute the disjoint sets (Venn regions)

# Double intersection
CM1_CM2_d8 <- Reduce(intersect, list(day8Genes_CM2, day8Genes_CM1))

# Unique only
CM1d8_only  <- setdiff(day8Genes_CM1, CM1_CM2_d8)
CM2d8_only    <- setdiff(day8Genes_CM2, CM1_CM2_d8)

venn_db_CM1 <- as.data.frame(bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "CM1d8_only",  gene = CM1d8_only),
  tibble(set = "CM2d8_only", gene = CM2d8_only),
  tibble(set = "inter",    gene = CM1_CM2_d8)
)) %>% mutate(day="day8")

# 3. Construct named region vector for eulerr
fit1_CM1 <- euler(c(
  "CM1d8"  = length(day8Genes_CM1),
  "CM1d8&CM2d8"= length(CM1_CM2_d8),
  "CM2d8" = length(day8Genes_CM2)
  ))
```

```{r Figure 1d updated barplot deg all clusters per day}
#Getting the gene list and selecting the top 10 per cluster/day
sigDGEs <- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/psbulk_sigGens__all_DayClusters.csv", row.names=1)


# Creating direction variable
sigDGEs$dir_sig[sigDGEs$logFC>0] <-"up"
sigDGEs$dir_sig[sigDGEs$logFC<0] <-"down"
#Adding new name
sigDGEs$cluster_name = factor(sigDGEs$cluster_name,
                                  labels = c("cMonocyte-IL"="CM1",                                                          "cMonocyte-S100A8"="CM2",                                                       "cMonocyte-COQ7"="CM3",                                                        "cMonocyte-ISG15"="CM4",
                                             "DCs1" ="DCs1",
                                             "DCs2" ="DCs2",
                                             "intMonocyte"= "intMonocyte",
                                             "ncMonocyte-CD16"= "ncMonocyte",
                                             "pDCs"="pDCs"))

sigDGEs<- sigDGEs[sigDGEs$day %in% c("day36","day8"),]
table(sigDGEs$cluster_name, sigDGEs$day )

sigDGEs$cluster_day <- paste0(sigDGEs$cluster_name, "_", sigDGEs$day)

table(sigDGEs$cluster_day, sigDGEs$dir_sig)


Fig1DMeta_Freq <- as.data.frame(table(sigDGEs$cluster_day, sigDGEs$dir_sig, sigDGEs$day))

#Renaming columns
colnames(Fig1DMeta_Freq)[1] ="cluster_day"
colnames(Fig1DMeta_Freq)[2] ="FC_direction"
colnames(Fig1DMeta_Freq)[3] ="Day_comparison"
colnames(Fig1DMeta_Freq)[4] ="Count"

Fig1DMeta_Freq <- separate(Fig1DMeta_Freq, "cluster_day", into=c("Celltype","Day"), sep="_", remove = FALSE )%>%
  mutate(rem=
           case_when(Day==Day_comparison  ~ "no",
                     Day!=Day_comparison & Count==0 ~ "yes"),
         Day_comparison=
           case_when(Day == "day8" ~ "Day0vsDay8",
                     Day == "day36" ~ "Day0vsDay36",))%>%
  filter(rem=="no")
##Adding factors

##Creating celltype factors
celltype_fact2<- c("CM1", "CM2","CM3","CM4","intMonocyte", "ncMonocyte","DCs1","DCs2","pDCs")
##Creating day factors
day_fact<- c("day8", "day36")
##Creating day comparsionfactors
daycom_fact<- c("Day0vsDay8", "Day0vsDay36")
dir_fact <- c("up", "down")

Fig1DMeta_Freq$Day <- factor(Fig1DMeta_Freq$Day, levels = day_fact)

Fig1DMeta_Freq$FC_direction <- factor(Fig1DMeta_Freq$FC_direction, levels = dir_fact)

# 
#Figure1D-Barplot with cell numbers per donor

                    aes(x = Celltype, y = Count, fill = FC_direction)) +
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(down = "#2166AC", up = "#B2182B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 400)) +

  theme(

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")

pop_clusD
```

### Upset plot with upregulated genes
```{r new Upset version michelle 270826 zp updated first up}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read input data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

psbDE_venn0 <- read.csv(
  "/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/venn_input_ibsm40monos.csv",
  row.names = 1
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create grouping variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

psbDE_venn2 <- psbDE_venn0 %>%
  mutate(
    groups = case_when(
      set == "d8_only"  ~ paste0(cluster_name, ".d8"),
      set == "d36_only" ~ paste0(cluster_name, ".d36"),
      set == "inter"    ~ paste0(
        cluster_name, ".d8&",
        cluster_name, ".d36"
      ),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    groups = factor(
      groups,
      levels = c(
        "CM1.d8", "CM1.d36", "CM1.d8&CM1.d36",
        "CM2.d8", "CM2.d36", "CM2.d8&CM2.d36",
        "CM3.d8", "CM3.d36", "CM3.d8&CM3.d36",
        "CM4.d8", "CM4.d36", "CM4.d8&CM4.d36"
      )
    ),

    # For genes shared between d8 and d36 within a cluster,
    # assign the appropriate day-specific group.
    groups2 = case_when(
      groups == "CM1.d8&CM1.d36" & day == "day8"  ~ "CM1.d8",
      groups == "CM1.d8&CM1.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM1.d36",

      groups == "CM2.d8&CM2.d36" & day == "day8"  ~ "CM2.d8",
      groups == "CM2.d8&CM2.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM2.d36",

      groups == "CM3.d8&CM3.d36" & day == "day8"  ~ "CM3.d8",
      groups == "CM3.d8&CM3.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM3.d36",

      groups == "CM4.d8&CM4.d36" & day == "day8"  ~ "CM4.d8",
      groups == "CM4.d8&CM4.d36" & day == "day36" ~ "CM4.d36",

      TRUE ~ as.character(groups)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Keep only UP-regulated genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

psbDE_venn2_up <- psbDE_venn2 %>%
  filter(dir_sig == "up")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert gene lists into named list for UpSet
# ------------------------------------------------------------

psbDE_venn2_up.ls <- split(
  psbDE_venn2_up$gene,
  f = psbDE_venn2_up$groups2
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create combination matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_up <- make_comb_mat(
  psbDE_venn2_up.ls,
  mode = "distinct"
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Remove combinations containing fewer than 5 genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m3_up <- m_up[,  comb_size(m_up) >= 5]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Inspect combinations that remain
# ------------------------------------------------------------

comb_df <- data.frame(
  combination = comb_name(m3_up),
  n_genes     = comb_size(m3_up)
)

# Sort table from largest to smallest for inspection
comb_df <- comb_df %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))

print(comb_df)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Automatically order UpSet columns by intersection size
#     HIGH -> LOW
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Get combination sizes
comb_sizes <- comb_size(m3_up)

# Get integer positions sorted by size (largest to smallest)
ordered_idx <- order(comb_sizes, decreasing = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Define colours for each cell population
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set_cols <- c(
  "CM1.d8"  = "#9e0142",
  "CM1.d36" = "#9e0142",

  "CM2.d8"  = "#f4a582",
  "CM2.d36" = "#f4a582",

  "CM3.d8"  = "#5e4fa2",
  "CM3.d36" = "#5e4fa2",

  "CM4.d8"  = "#66c2a5",
  "CM4.d36" = "#66c2a5"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Draw and save UpSet plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pdf(
  "/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/training_monos_data4graphs/UpsetR_DEGs_sharedamong_CM_dist_freq_withuponlyV3up_v3.pdf",
  height = 7,
  width  = 7
)

# Pass integer indices directly to UpSet
UpSet(m3_up,
      comb_order = ordered_idx,    # ← integer positions, not names
      pt_size = unit(8, "pt"),
      lwd     = unit(2, "pt"),

      top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(
        m3_up,
        show_annotation_name = FALSE,
        add_numbers          = TRUE,
        annotation_name_rot  = 90,
        axis_param           = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
        annotation_name_side = "left"
      ),

      right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(
        m3_up,
        add_numbers = TRUE,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 4, fill = set_cols),
        annotation_name_side = "top",
        axis_param = list(side = "top"),
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
        width = unit(3, "cm"),
        heatmap_height = unit(55, units = "pt")
      )
)

dev.off()
```

## Heatmap showing Average expression of sig uniquely & shared upregulated genes per day per celltype, for at least 3/4 subtypes. 

#### Methods

Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified using a pseudobulk approach across four classical monocyte subpopulations (CM1–CM4) at day 8 and day 36 post-infection. Only upregulated genes (log fold-change > 0) were retained for downstream classification.

For each subpopulation, DEGs were first classified into three mutually exclusive temporal categories using set operations: day 8-specific (genes significant at day 8 only), day 36-specific (genes significant at day 36 only), and shared (genes significant at both time points). To identify broadly regulated temporal patterns across subpopulations, each gene was then assigned a dominant temporal category based on a ratio of the number of subpopulations supporting that classification over the total number of subpopulations (n = 4). Genes were reclassified into a consensus temporal pattern — day 8-dominant, day 36-dominant, or shared — when a single temporal category was supported by 50% or more of subpopulations. Genes where no single category met this threshold, or where two categories tied at the maximum ratio, were flagged as ambiguous. This ratio-based reclassification replaces a fixed cluster-count threshold and provides a more proportional measure of cross-subpopulation consistency.

Average normalised expression values were z-score scaled and visualised as a heatmap, with genes annotated by their consensus temporal pattern to highlight coordinated transcriptional programmes across monocyte subpopulations.

#### Interpretation

The temporal classification of upregulated DEGs revealed three distinct expression patterns across CM1–CM4 monocyte subpopulations. Day 8-specific genes likely reflect an acute transcriptional response to peak parasitaemia, potentially encompassing innate immune activation and inflammatory signalling pathways. In contrast, day 36-specific genes suggest a late or sustained transcriptional programme, possibly associated with immune adaptation, resolution of inflammation, or functional reprogramming following parasite clearance. Genes shared across both time points represent a consistently maintained transcriptional state, potentially indicative of stable monocyte reprogramming persisting beyond acute infection — a pattern consistent with trained immunity.

The requirement that genes be upregulated in at least three of four subpopulations ensured that only broadly coordinated responses were captured, pointing to shared regulatory mechanisms across monocyte subsets rather than subtype-specific effects. Together, these findings suggest that malaria infection drives both a rapid and a sustained pan-monocyte transcriptional response, with the persistence of shared genes at day 36 raising the possibility of long-term epigenetic remodelling.

```{r heatmap of uniquely upregulated genes per day LATEST}
#Reading input
Average.df <- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/monosIBSM_Averagemat_LOGNORMALISED_daycluster_300925.csv", row.names = 1)

#Selecting the clusters name
cMonocytes <- c("CM1", "CM2", "CM3", "CM4")
rownames(Average.df) <- Average.df$day_cluster

str(Average.df)
Average.df$day <- factor(Average.df$day, levels = c("day0", "day8", "day36"))
Average.df$cluster <- factor(Average.df$cluster, levels = cMonocytes)

#### Subsetting cluster (for example one heatmap per cluster)
Average.sub <- Average.df[Average.df$cluster %in% c("CM1", "CM2", "CM3", "CM4"), ]
#Average.Tfh1CM <- Average.Tfh1CM[Average.Tfh1CM$day %in% c("day0", "day16"), ]
rownames(Average.sub) <- Average.sub$day_cluster
#### okay now to reorder EVERYTHING... 

my_order <- c("day0-CM1", "day0-CM1", "day0-CM1", "day0-CM1",
              "day8-CM1", "day8-CM1", "day8-CM1", "day8-CM1",
              "day36-CM1", "day36-CM1", "day36-CM1", "day36-CM1",
              "day0-CM2", "day0-CM2", "day0-CM2", "day0-CM2",
              "day8-CM2", "day8-CM2", "day8-CM2", "day8-CM2",
              "day36-CM2", "day36-CM2", "day36-CM2", "day36-CM2",
              "day0-CM3", "day0-CM3", "day0-CM3", "day0-CM3",
              "day8-CM3", "day8-CM3", "day8-CM3", "day8-CM3",
              "day36-CM3", "day36-CM3", "day36-CM3", "day36-CM3",
              "day0-CM4", "day0-CM4", "day0-CM4", "day0-CM4",
              "day8-CM4", "day8-CM4", "day8-CM4", "day8-CM4",
              "day36-CM4", "day36-CM4", "day36-CM4", "day36-CM4")

Average.sub <- Average.sub[match(my_order, rownames(Average.sub)), ]

Average.sub <- Average.sub %>%
  mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("day0","day8","day36")),
         cluster = factor(cluster, levels = cMonocytes )) %>%
  arrange(cluster, day)

#### Getting the gene list and selecting the top 10 per cluster/day ####

sigDGEs <- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/venn_input_ibsm40monos.csv", row.names=1)

#Adding new name
sigDGEs$cluster_name = factor(sigDGEs$cluster_name, levels = cMonocytes)
#filter the comparison of interest and the direction of the genes
merged_genes1 <- sigDGEs %>%
  filter(
    dir_sig == "up",
    day %in% c("day36", "day8"),
    set2 %in% c("d8_only", "d36_only", "d8&d36")
  ) %>%
  group_by(set2) %>%
  arrange(p_adj, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup()

merged_genes1$gene = gsub("-", ".", merged_genes1$gene)
merged_genes2 <- unique(merged_genes1$gene)

#### subsetting our selected genes
dfsub_d816<- as.matrix(Average.sub[, colnames(Average.sub) %in% merged_genes2])

dfsub_d816 <- as.matrix(dfsub_d816)
dfsub_d816 = scale(dfsub_d816)

col = list(Cluster = c("CM1" = "#9e0142",
                       "CM2" = "#f4a582",
                       "CM3" = "#5e4fa2",
                       "CM4" = "#66c2a5"),
            Day = c("day0" = "#bababa",
                   "day8" = "#fdae61",
                   "day36" = "blue"))

# ##We got high medium and low expression, we want 3 colors
# rng <- max(abs(dfsub_d816), na.rm = TRUE)  # or use abs(expr_z) if you built it
# rng <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng else 1  # fallback

# 3-color diverging palette: negative / zero / positive
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 4),
  c("#2166AC", "#FFFFFF", "#B2182B")   # blue - white - red (swap colors if you want)
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(Cluster=Average.sub$cluster,
                        Day=Average.sub$day,
                        col = col)

col_split <- factor(Average.sub$cluster, levels = c("CM1","CM2","CM3","CM4"))

row_split0 <- merged_genes1 %>% 
  filter(gene %in% merged_genes2) %>% # keep only genes in merged_genes2
  select(gene, set2) %>% 
  #distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%# one row per gene
  mutate(set2 = factor(set2, levels = c("d8_only", "d36_only","d8&d36")))

# Align 'set' to the heatmap row order (genes)
gene_order <- rownames(t(dfsub_d816))                       # rows of the heatmap
set_map    <- setNames(as.character(row_split0$set2), row_split0$gene)
row_set    <- factor(set_map[gene_order], levels = c("d8_only", "d36_only", "d8&d36"))

# Row annotation for 'set'
row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  Set = row_set,
  col = list(Set = c("d8_only" = "#fdae61", "d36_only" = "#0072B2", "d8&d36" ="#008837")),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

pdf(here("output/heatmap_D8andD36geneset_avexpdaycluster_nrev_v4_020926.pdf"), width = 8, height =10)

Heatmap(
  t(dfsub_d816),
  name = "AvExpr", col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = ha,
  left_annotation = row_ann,                 # <<< add row annotation
  cluster_rows = FALSE,                       # keep clustering order
  show_row_dend = FALSE,                     # <<< hide row dendrogram graphic
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,                  # (explicit; no column dendrogram)
  column_split = col_split,
  column_gap = unit(4, "mm"),
  row_split = row_set,       # <<< split rows by set (d8_only / d36_only)
  row_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
  column_title = "Genes",
  row_title = "Day-unique genes",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4)
)
dev.off()
```

```{r heatmap with the other group set2}
rownames(Average.df) <- Average.df$day_cluster

str(Average.df)
Average.df$day <- factor(Average.df$day, levels = c("day0", "day8", "day36"))
Average.df$cluster <- factor(Average.df$cluster, levels = cMonocytes)

#### Subsetting cluster (for example one heatmap per cluster)
Average.sub <- Average.df[Average.df$cluster %in% c("CM1", "CM2", "CM3", "CM4"), ]
#Average.Tfh1CM <- Average.Tfh1CM[Average.Tfh1CM$day %in% c("day0", "day16"), ]
rownames(Average.sub) <- Average.sub$day_cluster
#### okay now to reorder EVERYTHING... 

my_order <- c("day0-CM1", "day0-CM1", "day0-CM1", "day0-CM1",
              "day8-CM1", "day8-CM1", "day8-CM1", "day8-CM1",
              "day36-CM1", "day36-CM1", "day36-CM1", "day36-CM1",
              "day0-CM2", "day0-CM2", "day0-CM2", "day0-CM2",
              "day8-CM2", "day8-CM2", "day8-CM2", "day8-CM2",
              "day36-CM2", "day36-CM2", "day36-CM2", "day36-CM2",
              "day0-CM3", "day0-CM3", "day0-CM3", "day0-CM3",
              "day8-CM3", "day8-CM3", "day8-CM3", "day8-CM3",
              "day36-CM3", "day36-CM3", "day36-CM3", "day36-CM3",
              "day0-CM4", "day0-CM4", "day0-CM4", "day0-CM4",
              "day8-CM4", "day8-CM4", "day8-CM4", "day8-CM4",
              "day36-CM4", "day36-CM4", "day36-CM4", "day36-CM4")

Average.sub <- Average.sub[match(my_order, rownames(Average.sub)), ]

Average.sub <- Average.sub %>%
  mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("day0","day8","day36")),
         cluster = factor(cluster, levels = cMonocytes )) %>%
  arrange(cluster, day)

#### Getting the gene list and selecting the top 10 per cluster/day ####

sigDGEs <- read.csv("/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/IBSM40_pseudobulk_scRNA/output/venn_input_ibsm40monos.csv", row.names=1)

#Adding new name
sigDGEs$cluster_name = factor(sigDGEs$cluster_name, levels = cMonocytes)
#filter the comparison of interest and the direction of the genes
merged_genes1 <- sigDGEs %>%
  filter(
    dir_sig == "up",
    day %in% c("day36", "day8"),
    set2 %in% c("d8_only", "d36_only", "d8&d36", "other")
  ) %>%
  group_by(set2) %>%
  arrange(p_adj, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup()

merged_genes1$gene = gsub("-", ".", merged_genes1$gene)
merged_genes2 <- unique(merged_genes1$gene)

#### subsetting our selected genes
dfsub_d816<- as.matrix(Average.sub[, colnames(Average.sub) %in% merged_genes2])

dfsub_d816 <- as.matrix(dfsub_d816)
dfsub_d816 = scale(dfsub_d816)

col = list(Cluster = c("CM1" = "#9e0142",
                       "CM2" = "#f4a582",
                       "CM3" = "#5e4fa2",
                       "CM4" = "#66c2a5"),
            Day = c("day0" = "#bababa",
                   "day8" = "#fdae61",
                   "day36" = "blue"))

# ##We got high medium and low expression, we want 3 colors
# rng <- max(abs(dfsub_d816), na.rm = TRUE)  # or use abs(expr_z) if you built it
# rng <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng else 1  # fallback

# 3-color diverging palette: negative / zero / positive
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 4),
  c("#2166AC", "#FFFFFF", "#B2182B")   # blue - white - red (swap colors if you want)
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(Cluster=Average.sub$cluster,
                        Day=Average.sub$day,
                        col = col)

col_split <- factor(Average.sub$cluster, levels = c("CM1","CM2","CM3","CM4"))

row_split0 <- merged_genes1 %>% 
  filter(gene %in% merged_genes2) %>% # keep only genes in merged_genes2
  select(gene, set2) %>% 
  #distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%# one row per gene
  mutate(set2 = factor(set2, levels = c("d8_only", "d36_only","d8&d36", "other")))

# Align 'set' to the heatmap row order (genes)
gene_order <- rownames(t(dfsub_d816))                       # rows of the heatmap
set_map    <- setNames(as.character(row_split0$set2), row_split0$gene)
row_set    <- factor(set_map[gene_order], levels = c("d8_only", "d36_only", "d8&d36", "other"))

# Row annotation for 'set'
row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  Set = row_set,
  col = list(Set = c("d8_only" = "#fdae61", "d36_only" = "#0072B2", "d8&d36" ="#008837", "other"="grey")),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

pdf(here("output/heatmap_D8andD36geneset_avexpdaycluster_nrev_v4_020926_withFCGRB.pdf"), width = 8, height =10)

Heatmap(
  t(dfsub_d816),
  name = "AvExpr", col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = ha,
  left_annotation = row_ann,                 # <<< add row annotation
  cluster_rows = FALSE,                       # keep clustering order
  show_row_dend = FALSE,                     # <<< hide row dendrogram graphic
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,                  # (explicit; no column dendrogram)
  column_split = col_split,
  column_gap = unit(4, "mm"),
  row_split = row_set,       # <<< split rows by set (d8_only / d36_only)
  row_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
  column_title = "Genes",
  row_title = "Day-unique genes",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4)
)
dev.off()
```

## QC tables
```{r tables}
head(qc_tb)
head(report) 
##naming variables
colnames(qc_tb)[1] <-"uid"
report <- report%>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint2 =
           case_when(Timepoint %in% c("29", "27", "35") ~ "27",
                                Timepoint %in% c("15", "16")~"15",
                                Timepoint %in% c("8", "9")~"8",
                                TRUE ~ Timepoint),
    
    uid =
           case_when(Study == "QEC" ~ paste0(Study,"_",Part.ID),
                     Study == "QEM" ~ paste0(Study,"_",Part.ID, "_d", Timepoint2),
                     Study %in% c("CTM2002", "MMV367")~ paste0(Part.ID, "_d", Timepoint2))) %>%
  filter(grepl("M", Lib.ID))

report_s <- report[report$uid %in% qc_tb$uid,]

qc_tb1 <- left_join(qc_tb, report_s%>%select(uid,Lib.ID, Sequencing.library.ID, Batch ), by = "uid")

qc_tb1 <- qc_tb1%>%select(Lib.ID, Sequencing.library.ID, uid, Batch,
                        Fraction.of.Reads.in.Peaks, Transcription.Start.Site.Enrichment,
                        Non.Redundant.Fraction, PCR.Bottlenecking.Coefficient.1,
                        PCR.Bottlenecking.Coefficient.2,Percent.of.reads.aligned.to.genome)
colnames(seq_report)[1]<-"Sequencing.library.ID"
colnames(seq_report)[2]<-"Lib.ID"
colnames(seq_report)[6]<-"Sequencing depth (2x150bp M read pairs)"

qc_tb2 <- left_join(qc_tb1, seq_report %>%
                      select('Lib.ID',
                             'Sequencing depth (2x150bp M read pairs)'), by = "Lib.ID")

write.csv(qc_tb2, "/working_groups/boylelab/shared/ZulyPava/ATACseq_R4.4/ATAC_seq/output/training_paper_atac_plots/allstudies_qc_atacseq_table_complete.csv")
```
